summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the structure of a digital form to handle multiple tabs and non-form elements like maps and images. It was proposed that main tabs should be treated as external frames with separate JSON definitions, which would make the code clearer than the current setup.

Regarding component integration, it was agreed that components (like Angular components) could be embedded directly into the form structure, allowing them to be defined within the JSON data alongside standard form fields. This approach ensures all elements are managed in one place and fed by a single data object.

Additionally, for map components, the requirement is to select or utilize the current frame context so that the component only renders when a specific frame is selected.
decisions: Main tabs should be defined as external frames with separate JSON definitions.
Components (e.g., Angular components) can be embedded directly into the form structure and controlled by JSON data.
action_items: Attempt to demonstrate how the proposed component embedding structure works.
